title: skill-creator: Win11 cp1252 default raises UnicodeEncodeError on unencoded write_text() / open() — leaks subprocess workers on crash
author: m9751
body_preview: ## Summary  On Windows 11, Python 3.14 sets `sys.stdout.encoding` to `cp1252` (the Windows ANSI codepage) by default. Ten call sites across five scripts in `skills/skill-creator/scripts/` write text via `Path.write_text(...)` or `open(..., "w")` without an explicit `encoding=`, which then attempts to encode HTML/JSON content containing `✓` (U+2713) and `✗` (U+2717) through cp1252's charmap codec a...
